cond_0001.intro:
A Validation Engineer plans, implements, and monitors the validation strategy in highly regulated industries such as pharmaceutical or medical device manufacturing. Lead or support cleaning, equipment, utilities, sterilization and/or autoclave qualification due to equipment modifications for tech transfers, Make-Assess-Release (MAR) or routine re-qualification activities. Ensure the timely completion of Cleaning Monitoring as well as validation team assignments. Any deviations, anomalies or schedule impacting items are to be reported to site management. This position provides trained technical resources for the development and execution of validation protocols in accordance with OCN and global procedures. The person will maintain up-to-date training status in the [Product name masked] (or equivalent) system. Author and review qualification protocols, engineering change orders, SOP changes, Engineering commissioning and turnover packages. Approval support of any qualification protocols will require approval of the site Validation as well as Quality. Review Planned/Unplanned events and provide initial assessment for validation lead. Review of lifecycle documents for migration into new electronic system as well as for additional changes for MAR, Tech transfer. Responsible for on-time completion of validation activities according to overall current manufacturing schedule. Ensure coordination of Validation requirements with Quality, Manufacturing & Engineering. Ensure the integration of environmental health, safety, and security into the business processes, systems and programs while reporting safety and environmental incidents including injuries, illnesses, and safety suggestions within one's functional area. Foster a positive safety culture in which no one gets hurt.
This position provides resources for the controlled collection, assessment and reporting of scientific validation or study data in support of validation of processes. The data will be analyzed using algebraic and/or statistical methods to verify adherence to predetermined and approved process criteria. Reports will be written to communicate the outcome of the studies and/or validations. This position will provide sampling and inspection support for process equipment as part of the validation execution process. As such, the person must be trained on sampling and inspection procedures; and may be called upon to provide training for others as needed.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
5–7 Years of relevant validation engineer experience.
BA/BS in Engineering or Life Sciences.
Expert in current validation requirements and FDA expectation of facility, equipment, and computer validation.
Ability to manage and track validation progress in required detail with data basis and schedules.
Excellent teamwork, communication, and problem solving skills.
Preferred Requirements
Ability to establish and maintain good relationships with various site functional groups as well as external validation contractors and consultants.
Work in standard office environment.
May on occasion work in clean room environment with large mechanical equipment, piping, and pumps connecting to tanks serviced by high-pressure steam, water and air together this creates a loud environment.
May be exposed to hazardous materials.

Lead or support cleaning, equipment, utilities, sterilization and/or autoclave qualification due to equipment modifications for tech transfers, Make-Assess-Release (MAR) or routine re-qualification activities. Ensure the timely completion of Cleaning Monitoring as well as validation team assignments. Any deviations, anomalies or schedule impacting items are to be reported to site management. This position provides trained technical resources for the development and execution of validation protocols in accordance with OCN and global procedures. The person will maintain up-to-date training status in the [Product name masked] (or equivalent) system. Author and review qualification protocols, engineering change orders, SOP changes, Engineering commissioning and turnover packages. Approval support of any qualification protocols will require approval of the site Validation as well as Quality. Review Planned/Unplanned events and provide initial assessment for validation lead. Review of lifecycle documents for migration into new electronic system as well as for additional changes for MAR, Tech transfer. Responsible for on-time completion of validation activities according to overall current manufacturing schedule. Ensure coordination of Validation requirements with Quality, Manufacturing & Engineering. Ensure the integration of environmental health, safety, and security into the business processes, systems and programs while reporting safety and environmental incidents including injuries, illnesses, and safety suggestions within one's functional area. Foster a positive safety culture in which no one gets hurt.
This position provides resources for the controlled collection, assessment and reporting of scientific validation or study data in support of validation of processes. The data will be analyzed using algebraic and/or statistical methods to verify adherence to predetermined and approved process criteria. Reports will be written to communicate the outcome of the studies and/or validations. This position will provide sampling and inspection support for process equipment as part of the validation execution process. As such, the person must be trained on sampling and inspection procedures; and may be called upon to provide training for others as needed. Most people become stronger in validation work over time as they build experience and learn from feedback.
cond_0059.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
5–7 Years of relevant validation engineer experience.
BA/BS in Engineering or Life Sciences.
Expert in current validation requirements and FDA expectation of facility, equipment, and computer validation.
Ability to manage and track validation progress in required detail with data basis and schedules.
Good communication and teamwork skills and problem solving skills.
Preferred Requirements
Ability to establish and maintain good relationships with various site functional groups as well as external validation contractors and consultants.
Work in standard office environment.
May on occasion work in clean room environment with large mechanical equipment, piping, and pumps connecting to tanks serviced by high-pressure steam, water and air together this creates a load environment.
Maybe exposed to hazardous materials.

cond_0227.intro: A Validation Engineer plans, implements, and monitors the validation strategy in highly regulated industries such as pharmaceutical or medical device manufacturing.
cond_0227.responsibilities:
Lead or support cleaning, equipment, utilities, sterilization and/or autoclave qualification due to equipment modifications for tech transfers, Make-Assess-Release (MAR) or routine re-qualification activities. Ensure the timely completion of Cleaning Monitoring as well as validation team assignments. Any deviations, anomalies or schedule impacting items are to be reported to site management. This position provides trained technical resources for the development and execution of validation protocols in accordance with OCN and global procedures. The person will maintain up-to-date training status in the [Product name masked] (or equivalent) system. Author and review qualification protocols, engineering change orders, SOP changes, Engineering commissioning and turnover packages. Approval support of any qualification protocols will require approval of the site Validation as well as Quality. Review Planned/Unplanned events and provide initial assessment for validation lead. Review of lifecycle documents for migration into new electronic system as well as for additional changes for MAR, Tech transfer. Responsible for on-time completion of validation activities according to overall current manufacturing schedule. Ensure coordination of Validation requirements with Quality, Manufacturing & Engineering. Ensure the integration of environmental health, safety, and security into the business processes, systems and programs while reporting safety and environmental incidents including injuries, illnesses, and safety suggestions within one's functional area. Foster a positive safety culture in which no one gets hurt.
This position provides resources for the controlled collection, assessment and reporting of scientific validation or study data in support of validation of processes. The data will be analyzed using algebraic and/or statistical methods to verify adherence to predetermined and approved process criteria. Reports will be written to communicate the outcome of the studies and/or validations. This position will provide sampling and inspection support for process equipment as part of the validation execution process. As such, the person must be trained on sampling and inspection procedures; and may be called upon to provide training for others as needed.
cond_0227.requirements:
Minimum 7 years of demonstrated expertise in validation engineering in a relevant regulated industry.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Life Sciences required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Advanced knowledge of current validation requirements and FDA expectations for facility, equipment, and computer validation.
Proven track record of establishing and maintaining strong working relationships with site functional groups as well as external validation contractors and consultants.
Strong command of managing and tracking validation progress in required detail using databases and schedules.
Exceptional teamwork, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Strong written and verbal communication abilities.
Ability to work in a standard office environment.
May on occasion work in a clean room environment with large mechanical equipment, piping, and pumps connecting to tanks serviced by high-pressure steam, water and air together this creates a loud environment.
May be exposed to hazardous materials.

cond_0257.intro:
A Validation Engineer plans, implements, and monitors the validation strategy in highly regulated industries such as pharmaceutical or medical device manufacturing. Lead or support cleaning, equipment, utilities, sterilization and/or autoclave qualification due to equipment modifications for tech transfers, Make-Assess-Release (MAR) or routine re-qualification activities. Ensure the timely completion of Cleaning Monitoring as well as validation team assignments. Any deviations, anomalies or schedule impacting items are to be reported to site management. This position provides trained technical resources for the development and execution of validation protocols in accordance with OCN and global procedures. The person will maintain up-to-date training status in the [Product name masked] (or equivalent) system. Author and review qualification protocols, engineering change orders, SOP changes, Engineering commissioning and turnover packages. Approval support of any qualification protocols will require approval of the site Validation as well as Quality. Review Planned/Unplanned events and provide initial assessment for validation lead. Review of lifecycle documents for migration into new electronic system as well as for additional changes for MAR, Tech transfer. Responsible for on-time completion of validation activities according to overall current manufacturing schedule. Ensure coordination of Validation requirements with Quality, Manufacturing & Engineering. Ensure the integration of environmental health, safety, and security into the business processes, systems and programs while reporting safety and environmental incidents including injuries, illnesses, and safety suggestions within one's functional area. Foster a positive safety culture in which no one gets hurt.
This position provides resources for the controlled collection, assessment and reporting of scientific validation or study data in support of validation of processes. The data will be analyzed using algebraic and/or statistical methods to verify adherence to predetermined and approved process criteria. Reports will be written to communicate the outcome of the studies and/or validations. This position will provide sampling and inspection support for process equipment as part of the validation execution process. As such, the person must be trained on sampling and inspection procedures; and may be called upon to provide training for others as needed. Most people become stronger in validation work over time as they build experience and learn from feedback.

cond_0378.intro: A Validation Engineer coordinates, implements, and monitors the validation strategy in highly regulated industries such as pharmaceutical or medical device manufacturing. This position works alongside the validation team and site functions to support the development and execution of validation protocols in accordance with OCN and global procedures.
cond_0378.responsibilities:
Coordinate with the team to lead or support cleaning, equipment, utilities, sterilization and/or autoclave qualification due to equipment modifications for tech transfers, Make-Assess-Release (MAR) or routine re-qualification activities.
Help ensure the timely completion of Cleaning Monitoring as well as validation team assignments.
Share updates on any deviations, anomalies or schedule impacting items with site management.
Maintain up-to-date training status in the [Product name masked] (or equivalent) system.
Collaborate on authoring and reviewing qualification protocols, engineering change orders, SOP changes, engineering commissioning and turnover packages.
Support approval of qualification protocols in coordination with site Validation and Quality.
Review Planned/Unplanned events and provide initial assessment to the validation lead.
Work with the team to review lifecycle documents for migration into new electronic systems as well as for additional changes for MAR and Tech transfer.
Help ensure on-time completion of validation activities according to the overall current manufacturing schedule.
Coordinate Validation requirements with Quality, Manufacturing and Engineering.
Support the integration of environmental health, safety, and security into business processes, systems and programs; report safety and environmental incidents including injuries, illnesses, and safety suggestions within one's functional area.
Foster a positive safety culture in which no one gets hurt.
Work alongside the team to support the controlled collection, assessment and reporting of scientific validation or study data in support of validation of processes.
Assist in analyzing data using algebraic and/or statistical methods to verify adherence to predetermined and approved process criteria.
Help write reports to communicate the outcome of studies and/or validations.
Provide sampling and inspection support for process equipment as part of the validation execution process; may be called upon to assist in training others on sampling and inspection procedures as needed.
cond_0378.requirements:
5–7 Years of relevant validation engineer experience.
BA/BS in Engineering or Life Sciences.
Expert in current validation requirements and FDA expectation of facility, equipment, and computer validation.
Establish and maintain good relationships with various site functional groups as well as external validation contractors and consultants.
Ability to manage and track validation progress in required detail with data basis and schedules.
Excellent team work skills, communication and problem solving skills.
Good communication.
Work in standard office environment.
May on occasion work in clean room environment with large mechanical equipment, piping, and pumps connecting to tanks serviced by high-pressure steam, water and air together this creates a loud environment.
Maybe exposed to hazardous materials.

cond_0388.intro:
A Validation Engineer plans, implements, and monitors the validation strategy in highly regulated industries such as pharmaceutical or medical device manufacturing. Lead or support cleaning, equipment, utilities, sterilization and/or autoclave qualification due to equipment modifications for tech transfers, Make-Assess-Release (MAR) or routine re-qualification activities. Ensure the timely completion of Cleaning Monitoring as well as validation team assignments. Any deviations, anomalies or schedule impacting items are to be reported to site management. This position provides trained technical resources for the development and execution of validation protocols in accordance with OCN and global procedures. The person will maintain up-to-date training status in the [Product name masked] (or equivalent) system. Author and review qualification protocols, engineering change orders, SOP changes, Engineering commissioning and turnover packages. Approval support of any qualification protocols will require approval of the site Validation as well as Quality. Review Planned/Unplanned events and provide initial assessment for validation lead. Review of lifecycle documents for migration into new electronic system as well as for additional changes for MAR, Tech transfer. Responsible for on-time completion of validation activities according to overall current manufacturing schedule. Ensure coordination of Validation requirements with Quality, Manufacturing & Engineering. Ensure the integration of environmental health, safety, and security into the business processes, systems and programs while reporting safety and environmental incidents including injuries, illnesses, and safety suggestions within one's functional area. Foster a positive safety culture in which no one gets hurt.
This position provides resources for the controlled collection, assessment and reporting of scientific validation or study data in support of validation of processes. The data will be analyzed using algebraic and/or statistical methods to verify adherence to predetermined and approved process criteria. Reports will be written to communicate the outcome of the studies and/or validations. This position will provide sampling and inspection support for process equipment as part of the validation execution process. As such, the person must be trained on sampling and inspection procedures; and may be called upon to provide training for others as needed.
cond_0388.requirements:
5 -7 Years of relevant validation engineer experience.
BA/BS in Engineering or Life Sciences.
Expert in current validation requirements and FDA expectation of facility, equipment, and computer validation.
Establish and maintain good relationships with various site functional groups as well as external validation contractors and consultants.
Ability to manage and track validation progress in required detail with data basis and schedules.
Excellent team work skills communication and problem solving skills.
Good communication.
Work in standard office environment.
May on occasion work in clean room environment with large mechanical equipment, piping, and pumps connecting to tanks serviced by high-pressure steam, water and air together this creates a load environment.
Maybe exposed to hazardous materials.

Lead or support cleaning, equipment, utilities, sterilization and/or autoclave qualification due to equipment modifications for tech transfers, Make-Assess-Release (MAR) or routine re-qualification activities. Ensure the timely completion of Cleaning Monitoring as well as validation team assignments. Any deviations, anomalies or schedule impacting items are to be reported to site management. This position provides trained technical resources for the development and execution of validation protocols in accordance with OCN and global procedures. The person will maintain up-to-date training status in the [Product name masked] (or equivalent) system. Author and review qualification protocols, engineering change orders, SOP changes, Engineering commissioning and turnover packages. Approval support of any qualification protocols will require approval of the site Validation as well as Quality. Review Planned/Unplanned events and provide initial assessment for validation lead. Review of lifecycle documents for migration into new electronic system as well as for additional changes for MAR, Tech transfer. Responsible for on-time completion of validation activities according to overall current manufacturing schedule. Ensure coordination of Validation requirements with Quality, Manufacturing & Engineering. Ensure the integration of environmental health, safety, and security into the business processes, systems and programs while reporting safety and environmental incidents including injuries, illnesses, and safety suggestions within one's functional area. Foster a positive safety culture in which no one gets hurt.
This position provides resources for the controlled collection, assessment and reporting of scientific validation or study data in support of validation of processes. The data will be analyzed using algebraic and/or statistical methods to verify adherence to predetermined and approved process criteria. Reports will be written to communicate the outcome of the studies and/or validations. This position will provide sampling and inspection support for process equipment as part of the validation execution process. As such, the person must be trained on sampling and inspection procedures; and may be called upon to provide training for others as needed.
cond_0398.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Minimum 7 years of demonstrated expertise in validation engineering in a regulated industry.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Life Sciences required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Deep knowledge of current validation requirements and FDA expectations for facility, equipment, and computer validation.
Proven track record managing and tracking validation progress with databases and schedules in required detail.
Exceptional teamwork, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Preferred Requirements
Established ability to build and maintain strong relationships with site functional groups, external validation contractors, and consultants.
Proficiency working in a standard office environment as well as occasional clean room environments involving large mechanical equipment, piping, pumps, and high-pressure steam, water, and air systems.
Experience working in environments with potential exposure to hazardous materials.
cond_0398.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0398.values: We value strong results, high standards, and the pursuit of excellent work. We believe organizations perform best when they are guided by ambition and quality.

cond_0474.intro: A Validation Engineer plans, implements, and monitors the validation strategy in highly regulated industries such as pharmaceutical or medical device manufacturing. This position provides trained technical resources for the development and execution of validation protocols in accordance with OCN and global procedures. The person will maintain up-to-date training status in the [Product name masked] (or equivalent) system. This position also provides resources for the controlled collection, assessment and reporting of scientific validation or study data in support of validation of processes. Reports will be written to communicate the outcome of the studies and/or validations.
cond_0474.responsibilities:
Lead or support cleaning, equipment, utilities, sterilization and/or autoclave qualification due to equipment modifications for tech transfers, Make-Assess-Release (MAR) or routine re-qualification activities.

Report any deviations, anomalies or schedule impacting items directly to site management.
Author and review qualification protocols, engineering change orders, SOP changes, Engineering commissioning and turnover packages.
Coordinate approval of qualification protocols with the site Validation and Quality teams.
Review Planned/Unplanned events and provide initial assessment for validation lead.
Review lifecycle documents for migration into new electronic system as well as for additional changes for MAR and Tech transfer.
Stay in regular contact with Quality, Manufacturing, and Engineering to coordinate Validation requirements and keep alignment across teams.
Actively contribute to on-time completion of validation activities according to the overall current manufacturing schedule.
Provide sampling and inspection support for process equipment as part of the validation execution process; train others on sampling and inspection procedures as needed.
Integrate environmental health, safety, and security into business processes, systems and programs; report safety and environmental incidents including injuries, illnesses, and safety suggestions within one's functional area.
Foster a positive safety culture in which no one gets hurt.

5–7 Years of relevant validation engineer experience.
BA/BS in Engineering or Life Sciences.

Strong teamwork, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Ability to establish and maintain good working relationships with various site functional groups as well as external validation contractors and consultants.
Comfortable working in a standard office environment as well as occasionally in a clean room environment with large mechanical equipment, piping, and pumps connecting to tanks serviced by high-pressure steam, water, and air, which creates a loud environment.

cond_0503.intro: A Validation Engineer plans, implements, and monitors the validation strategy in highly regulated industries such as pharmaceutical or medical device manufacturing. This position provides resources for the controlled collection, assessment and reporting of scientific validation or study data in support of validation of processes. The data will be analyzed using algebraic and/or statistical methods to verify adherence to predetermined and approved process criteria. Reports will be written to communicate the outcome of the studies and/or validations. This position will provide sampling and inspection support for process equipment as part of the validation execution process. As such, the person must be trained on sampling and inspection procedures; and may be called upon to provide training for others as needed.
cond_0503.responsibilities:
Lead cleaning, equipment, utilities, sterilization and/or autoclave qualification due to equipment modifications for tech transfers, Make-Assess-Release (MAR) or routine re-qualification activities.
Drive timely completion of Cleaning Monitoring as well as validation team assignments.
Report any deviations, anomalies or schedule impacting items to site management.
Execute validation protocols in accordance with OCN and global procedures.
Maintain up-to-date training status in the [Product name masked] (or equivalent) system.
Author and review qualification protocols, engineering change orders, SOP changes, Engineering commissioning and turnover packages.
Oversee approval support of any qualification protocols, requiring sign-off from site Validation and Quality.
Review Planned/Unplanned events and deliver initial assessment for validation lead.
Lead review of lifecycle documents for migration into new electronic system as well as for additional changes for MAR, Tech transfer.
Own on-time completion of validation activities according to overall current manufacturing schedule.
Direct coordination of Validation requirements with Quality, Manufacturing & Engineering.
Ensure the integration of environmental health, safety, and security into the business processes, systems and programs while reporting safety and environmental incidents including injuries, illnesses, and safety suggestions within one's functional area.
Foster a positive safety culture in which no one gets hurt.
cond_0503.requirements:
5-7 Years of relevant validation engineer experience.
BA/BS in Engineering or Life Sciences.
Expert in current validation requirements and FDA expectation of facility, equipment, and computer validation.
Establish and maintain good relationships with various site functional groups as well as external validation contractors and consultants.
Ability to manage and track validation progress in required detail with data basis and schedules.
Excellent team work skills communication and problem solving skills.
Good communication.
Work in standard office environment.
May on occasion work in clean room environment with large mechanical equipment, piping, and pumps connecting to tanks serviced by high-pressure steam, water and air together this creates a load environment.
Maybe exposed to hazardous materials.

cond_0581.intro:
A Validation Engineer plans, implements, and monitors the validation strategy in highly regulated industries such as pharmaceutical or medical device manufacturing. Lead or support cleaning, equipment, utilities, sterilization and/or autoclave qualification due to equipment modifications for tech transfers, Make-Assess-Release (MAR) or routine re-qualification activities. Ensure the timely completion of Cleaning Monitoring as well as validation team assignments. Any deviations, anomalies or schedule impacting items are to be reported to site management. This position provides trained technical resources for the development and execution of validation protocols in accordance with OCN and global procedures. The person will maintain up-to-date training status in the [Product name masked] (or equivalent) system. Author and review qualification protocols, engineering change orders, SOP changes, Engineering commissioning and turnover packages. Approval support of any qualification protocols will require approval of the site Validation as well as Quality. Review Planned/Unplanned events and provide initial assessment for validation lead. Review of lifecycle documents for migration into new electronic system as well as for additional changes for MAR, Tech transfer. Responsible for on-time completion of validation activities according to overall current manufacturing schedule. Ensure coordination of Validation requirements with Quality, Manufacturing & Engineering. Ensure the integration of environmental health, safety, and security into the business processes, systems and programs while reporting safety and environmental incidents including injuries, illnesses, and safety suggestions within one's functional area. Foster a positive safety culture in which no one gets hurt.
This position provides resources for the controlled collection, assessment and reporting of scientific validation or study data in support of validation of processes. The data will be analyzed using algebraic and/or statistical methods to verify adherence to predetermined and approved process criteria. Reports will be written to communicate the outcome of the studies and/or validations. This position will provide sampling and inspection support for process equipment as part of the validation execution process. As such, the person must be trained on sampling and inspection procedures; and may be called upon to provide training for others as needed. Most people become stronger in validation work over time as they build experience and learn from feedback.

cond_0591.intro: A Validation Engineer plans, implements, and monitors the validation strategy in highly regulated industries such as pharmaceutical or medical device manufacturing. This position provides resources for the controlled collection, assessment and reporting of scientific validation or study data in support of validation of processes. The data will be analyzed using algebraic and/or statistical methods to verify adherence to predetermined and approved process criteria. Reports will be written to communicate the outcome of the studies and/or validations. This position will provide sampling and inspection support for process equipment as part of the validation execution process. As such, the person must be trained on sampling and inspection procedures; and may be called upon to provide training for others as needed.

Review of lifecycle documents for migration into new electronic system as well as for additional changes for MAR, Tech transfer.
Responsible for on-time completion of validation activities according to overall current manufacturing schedule.
Actively coordinate Validation requirements with Quality, Manufacturing & Engineering on a daily basis, clarifying requirements and walking teams through decisions as needed.
Ensure the integration of environmental health, safety, and security into the business processes, systems and programs while reporting safety and environmental incidents including injuries, illnesses, and safety suggestions within one's functional area.
Foster a positive safety culture in which no one gets hurt.

BA/BS in Engineering or Life Sciences.

Ability to manage and track validation progress in required detail with data basis and schedules.
Excellent team work skills, communication and problem solving skills.
